title: Sister Light
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Lush piano chords open the track quietly in A minor before a TR-707 rim shot and gentle bass sine ease it into motion. The arrangement flowers into a bright chorus with four-note jazz-flavored piano voicings, a lilting melodic run, and full kick-snare drive before winding down to a bare piano close.
